summary: TSMC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC reporting a routine, administrative adjustment to its Q1 2026 cash dividend per common share. The board had approved a NT$7.0 per share dividend on May 12, 2026, totaling NT$181,526,590,469, payable October 8, 2026. Due to reclamation of shares from restricted stock awards between approval and record date, the per-share dividend was adjusted slightly to NT$7.00000137. This is a standard corporate action, not a special situation; no M&A, tender, spin-off, or strategic change is involved. Watch for no further action; purely arithmetic adjustment.
